title: A deposit is charged to the owning location's payment account
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including BOTH Part sales - Create & Edit AND Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • Two locations exist.
  • The Location-A sale: a part sale owned by one location (for example Location A) while the user has a different location (Location B) selected.
custom_steps:
1. With Location B selected, take a deposit on the Location-A sale.
  2. Check which location's account the deposit charges.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The deposit is charged to the account of the location that owns the part sale (Location A), not the location the user has selected (Location B).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10269 (Take a deposit on a part sale); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 8; design canvas boards S8_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R14: “A deposit is charged to the account of the location that owns the part sale, not the location the user happens to have selected”
